title: automate-changelog-and-onboard-lyra-20b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Ava Chen
description: Onboard Lyra-20B v1.0 into the model registry with performance profiles, metadata, and automated changelog/release notes generation. Motivation: Lyra-20B is a high-throughput encoder-decoder variant we want available in hosted and dedicated deployments. This PR adds canonical metadata, validated perf profiles (latency/throughput on A100/RTX6000 equivalencies), scoring prompts used for evaluation, and a small automation script that appends a formatted changelog entry to MODEL_CHANGELOG.md based on perf job outputs. The description below includes commits summary, changed files, test results, and review notes.
commits: 3 commits: (1) add lyra-20b v1.0 metadata and perf profiles; (2) add perf harness config and evaluation prompts; (3) add changelog automation script + CI job config
review_comments: Diego Martinez: Can you include the exact A100 and RTX-equivalent numbers and the sequence-length distribution used for perf runs? Also please add a short note on quantization profiles used.
Ava Chen (author): Added detailed A100/RTX numbers and seq-len histograms to perf_profiles.yaml, and included quantization recommendations (int8 and fp16) in metadata.json.
Priya Nair: Automation script looks good. Please ensure the changelog entry is idempotent when CI re-runs and include a test for that behavior.

Ava Chen (author): Added idempotency check to auto_changelog.py and unit test in .github/workflows/perf-regression.yml to run the script in dry-run mode before committing. Updated PR with tests passing.
Liam O'Connor: Approved after addressing minor docs nit (changelog format example).
release_notes:
- Onboarded Lyra-20B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and evaluation prompts.
- Added automated changelog generation that extracts perf summary and appends a formatted entry to MODEL_CHANGELOG.md.
- Recommended deployment profiles: A100-40GB baseline, fp16 quantization recommended for hosted; int8 profile available for Dedicated with slight quality tradeoff.
merge_details: Merged via squash on 2025-02-18 by Priya Nair. Squash commit includes a perf summary snippet and auto_changelog invocation. Changelog entry verified in post-merge job.
notes_for_reviewers: Perf runs were executed against the perf-lab A100 pool with sequence-length distribution 32/128/512 (50/40/10). Throughput numbers reported in perf_profiles.yaml are median of 5 runs. The automated changelog only records stable metrics when integration-perf job succeeds to avoid noisy entries.
test_plan: 1) Run .github workflow perf-regression.yml which: sets up model files, runs evaluation harness, writes perf summary JSON, and executes auto_changelog.py in dry-run then commit mode. 2) Validate MODEL_CHANGELOG.md contains single entry for Lyra-20B v1.0 after merge. 3) Run smoke inference using the registry metadata in a dedicated sandbox (latency < 120ms p95 on A100, throughput > 1.2 tokens/ms baseline).
impact_summary: Adds new model to registry; does not change serving runtime. Automation reduces manual changelog drift and ensures perf-based release notes are reproducible.
security_considerations: No secrets introduced. Changelog automation runs in CI with read-only access to release artifacts; any credentials required for private artifact uploads are fetched from CI secrets and not stored in repo.
backwards_compatibility: This onboarding is additive; existing registry consumers are unaffected. Metadata schema followed existing v1.2 conventions.
qa_signoff: QA perf validation completed by Diego Martinez on 2025-02-17. Post-merge verification passed on 2025-02-18.
